visuals.after_heading: The fix is a system, not more hustle
visuals.headline: A simple weekly system

items.title: Block selling time
items.text: Book prospecting and LinkedIn time before the week fills up.

items.title: Weekly scorecard
items.text: Track selling activity next to pipeline movement, visible to the team.

items.title: Monday 15-min review
items.text: Check who posted, who followed up, and what worked.

items.title: Batch the admin
items.text: Fix a window for CRM updates so it doesn't fragment selling time.

visuals.alt: A four-step weekly system for protecting selling time: block selling time, run a weekly scorecard, hold a 15-minute Monday review, and batch admin work.
